nom: Vichy Mineral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream

avis.texte: This stuff is definitely moisturizing with a great texture but the smell is genuinely awful. It smells like old lady perfume and that is enough to demotivate me to use it. Probably should have returned it right away. I can't wait till it's done so I can move on to something else.

avis.titre: Would totally buy this product again!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is so creamy! The smell is very nice. Once applied to my skin it felt very moisturizing and hydrating. Waking up the next morning my skin felt hydrated and plump. Highly recommend!

I have tried many moisturizers i can't believe now at 41 i found this its not sticky smelly itchy or irritating and peeling. It's literally lays on your face like a silk like creme and you just feel it doing its magic rehydrating and sinking into your pores. I woke up this morning and after one use my skin felt so hydrated and soft i came home and over applied because it's really that luxurious moisturizer that i need for a good price. Im going to try not to use so much tmrw but like i said it lays on my skin like silk creamy and omg after one night im beyond impressed. I cant wait to see my skin thrive with the use of this first bottle to me this is the holly grail its not lemure but i feel pampered img best hydration moisturizer non gressy with a clean smell no sticky feeling ir peeling. I will definitely be purchasing this in addition to trying other vishy products i am mesmorized in just one application and tonight over saturated lol i cant help my self this is truly the best
This was similar to a wayer cream, great price, but honestly it wasn't impressive. I ended up using as body cream since it did nothing for my face and i hate wasting products.

This is a really comfortable and moisturizing night cream. It doesn't have any ingredients that cause acne, which is almost impossible to find in the Vichy brand and in night creams in general. I just wish they made this fragrance-free. It has a steong "old lasy" perfume smell that really turned me off.

Absolutely amazing. I love the entire mineral 89 vichy line. This is my new addition. I love the faint scent and it is moistuizing at night. I have no broken out once since using it for 2 weeks. LOVE it! I have combo skin.

Vichy Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream is a lightweight yet nourishing night cream that leaves skin feeling soft, hydrated, and refreshed by morning. It absorbs well without feeling greasy, and the calming scent adds a nice touch to a nighttime routine. Great for normal to dry skin, though the fragrance may not suit sensitive types. It's not at all overpowering, I have dry skin and can be sensitive to scents.
It's fine- but it's not an improvement over other brands I've used. The smell is pleasant, but I've used moisturizers that are better. Seems expensive for what it does.

I reviewed this Mineral 89 Overnight Moisturizer from Vichy and fell in love! The cream is so smooth and soft and it left my skin feeling smooth & moisturized! I highly recommend it! I received this product as part of a free sample program.

I received this moisturizer from Vichy in exchange for my honest review. I love this night cream! It provides a super hydrating layer of cream to help refresh skin overnight. It feels kinda heavy after application while it's locking in that moisture. The smell kind of reminds me of the pond's crème.

avis.titre: I will definitely buy this product when sample is gone!
avis.texte: I use this product in mornings and then apply my makeup over it after washing my face. And the eye cream I use st night. I can definitely see results already in the softness of my face & it isn't dry anymore. It's more youthful looking.

absolutely love Minéral 89 Moisture! Nighttime recovery From the very first use, my skin felt hydrated, refreshed, and so soft. It has such a lightweight texture that absorbs beautifully without leaving any residue, and my skin feels plump and healthy all day. It's truly exceptional and has become an essential part of my daily skincare routine. I can't imagine ever being without it!

This cream is very luxurious. The texture, is so nice and thick. I love the feeling on my skin. I do have sensitive skin and this did not burn putting it on, and has a pleasant and not overpowering smell. Unfortunately though I think it was a bit too thick for my skin as I broke out with some acne overnight the first few times I y not be able to use it. But if your skin isn't sensitive, I would reccommend as it is highly moisturizing!

I wasnt a huge fan of the moisturizer, it didnt leave my skin feeling great in general but not worse than before and still a bit dry. Personally won't get it again but it has a nice texture and packaging!

I would recommend this. This has definitely helped with my skin barrier and moisturizing, especially at night. I love how it has made my skin glowing and I cannot tell you that enough good things about this product

avis.titre: I love this news that time cream 🙌🏽
avis.texte: Love love love this cream! Not only does it help me with my bed time routine but it smells so good and leaves my skin feeling silky soft.

received this as a free sample. I really enjoyed the product. It was a thick cream with a light scent. It applies smoothly and absorbs into the skin quickly. My skin felt instantly hydrated and the next morning it was soft - there was slight improvement in skin texture. I am not sure I would replace my current night moisturizer with this though.

I received this product from BzzAgent in exchange for my review. I love using this night cream. It feels so light and smooth. It absorbs fast and has a non-greasy feel. It gives me a nice glowy, plump look afterward. It does have a light scent which I think smells good. I really enjoyed using it.

The cream is thick and doesn't contain any harsh fragrance but DOES contain fragrance. I'd describe it as powdery and clean. It took about a week to see a pretty huge improvement but that's not to say I didn't see it the first 2 days. A little dollop gives a good amount of coverage but maybe more needed for the neck area. It helped make my skin look plump although I can't say much on the affect of the melatonin as I'm not sure what that would affect. Overall, for the price and it not causing breakouts, it's worth it.

avis.titre: I am definitely adding this product to my beauty must haves!
avis.texte: I really love this moisturizing cream. It provided a ton of moisture to my face and neck without being to thick or greasy. The cream absorbs quickly and smells amazing!

I received Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream in exchange for my honest review. This product is lightweight and quickly absorbs into the skin. It has a pleasant lavender scent which is not overpowering at all. It does not leave a greasy feeling like most other night creams. I will be continuing to use this to see if it helps to minimize some fine lines.

I received this product as part of a free sample program. The first thing I noticed when using this product was how creamy the consistency is. It felt really luxurious and the scent was plseant. After using the product for a few weeks, my skin feels so soft. I didnt notice any change to my fine lines and wrinkles but my skin is definitely soft.

The packaging is so clean and luxurious. The scent is amazingly clean. It absorbs nicely into my skin and doesn't leave a mess in my pillows or bedding. When I wake up, my skin feels so nourished, hydrated, and pampered. I have now added this to my bedtime routine and will keep it as a staple.

I recently tried Vichy's Mineral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream, and I'm really impressed! The creamy texture feels luxurious, and the lavender scent is so soothing. My skin feels more hydrated and plump by morning, which is a huge win. It's gentle enough for my sensitive skin, and I love pairing it with the Mineral 89 Booster Serum. If you're looking for a night cream that delivers, this one is definitely worth trying!
This night cream absorbs so well. It doesn't leave a heavy film and pairs beautifully with my serums. And when my skin is feeling extra dry, I place a bit of a oil serum on top for a slugging effect.

I love how lightweight the Vichy Mineral 89 night cream is. It's not greasy and does not leave a residue on my pillow. I wake with my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. I have sensitive skin and this cream does not irritate it. The scent is ok, but not bad enough to stop using. I will continue to use and I will recommend this product to my friends.

A little bit of product goes a long way, and glides on smoothly. The texture has a thick cream base. It does have a slight sticky film to it after applying but maintains skin moisture overnight. My skin feels less dry and plump in the morning.

I recieved this product for free for my honest review. I like how this night cream feels on my face. It soaks in very quickly, leaving no greasy feel. It is lightweight and does not leave a waxy feel on my face. I felt like it helped soften my forehead wrinkles. I enjoy this product a lot.

The Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream is great. I received a sample and I loved it. It is very hydrating with no strong scent. It leaves your face feeling very refreshed after applying it. I noticed a nice glow on my face after putting it on and makes my skin look plump. I love the texture of the cream itself because it feels whipped. I would recommend as a daily night time cream.

I've been using Vichy Minéral 89 Night Cream and really enjoy it. The texture is light and sinks in quickly, but my skin still feels soft and refreshed in the morning. It gives me that well-rested look without being heavy or greasy. Best part it's affordable for how well it works, and a little goes a long way. Definitely a great pick if you want hydration that won't break the bank.

I received this product from BzzAgent in exchange for my review. This cream is really thick, but goes on so smoothly and dries quickly. It's very hydrating and I wake up with my skin feeling nice. It does have a scent, but it is not overly strong.

avis.titre: Too much fragrance and too lightweight
avis.texte: This night cream is good, but I probably will not repurchase. I have sensitive skin but this did not break me out, which was great. The downsides are how much fragrance is in it, and how lightweight it is.

avis.titre: The smell alone makes me use it.
avis.texte: I put this on nightly after my shower routine. I don't usually use night creams as I've noticed before hand that I buy them with good intentions but I don't follow throw with a routine and they end up sitting on the shelf. With Vichy Night Cream the smell alone makes me eager to use it. I don't know what it is, the smell is something familiar but not. I love that the cream is something light feeling and that the smell isn't heavy. I love scents but when they're too strong I can get nauseated quickly especially with a product going on my face. I'm happy to report no issues with my sensitive skin, no breakouts, redness, etc. I don't ow if I've been using the product long enough for really any benefits yet but I'll continue until my jar is gone.

I liked that the fragrance was not overwhelming, but some may find it bothersome if you don't like products with fragrance. For a night cream, it left me wanting more. I like my night creams to be extremely hydrating and lock in all of the other skincare I layered before it, and this absorbed into the skin too quickly for a night cream. I have been using it as a daytime moisturizer for this reason.

avis.titre: It may be growing on me
avis.texte: I received this product from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. The cream consistency is unlike any I've tried in the past. Its weirdly thick but doesn't go on feeling thick. It also dries down quickly but then bounces back to be hydrating. My only caveat is the smell. It smells like something I would've found in my grandmother's medicine cabinet; flowery but generic. I'll keep using it to see how it does but overall a solid product.

I received a sample of Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream a few weeks back, so that I could give an honest review of the product. I love it! As a 58-year-old my skin has seen a lot and had been dry and drawn looking for the past few years. After using Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream I have seen a noticeable difference in the hydration and plumpness of my skin. The cream itself is light with a slight scent that is not perfumy or overpowering. I would recommend this to anyone looking to approve the appearance of their skin.

avis.titre: Unfortunately product has super strong scent
avis.texte: I liked the consistency of this product but unfortunately I could not use it more than once due to the super strong perfume smell. I actually had to wash it off my face as it bothered me so much and I would not even consider myself very sensitive to scents

avis.titre: A wonderful night cream that leaves skin soft
avis.texte: My skin has changed recently. It used to be really oily, and lately I would say that it is combination and definitely aging (I'm in my mid-40's). I have been looking for a moisturizer that makes my skin feel recovered in the morning, a good mix of hydration, protective barrier, and something that works quickly. I like that it's lightly fragranced as so many moisturizers are heavily scented which bothers me, especially at night. I also find that it absorbs super-quickly without leaving a greasy texture behind. The only reason I gave it four stars is because I feel like there may be an additional step needed for fine lines. But for the price point, I do like it and recommend it.

I received this product as part of a free sample program. Beautiful tranquil scent that past products I've used haven't had. Absorbs quickly leaving a dewy finish. It has melatonin which I haven't used nor heard about in a skin care products. I did feel that the melatonin helped me fall asleep faster. I do find that my face looks hydrated/plump when I awake. I did I did feel that the melatonin helped me fall asleep faster. Compared to other night creams/moisturizers I've used in past.

Firstly, I love the smell. I know that's not something that's normally a selling point really, but I had to mention it. Personally, I found that my skin didn't feel greasy or heavy in the morning. That could be because I'm in my 40's and my skin is dryer than it used to be? I don't know, but my face felt nice and soft in the morning. I use it a little in the morning as well actually, but just around my eyes since those are a problem spot for me. I would use this cream again, I like it quite a bit.

avis.titre: Good product, but the smell is too strong
avis.texte: I like the texture of this cream. It goes on very nicely, has a cooling effect, and feels luxurious on the skin. My one caveat is that it has a relatively strong and somewhat unpleasant fragrance. I would recommend this to a friend if they enjoyed the scent, but I could see it being somewhat divisive.
I used this product at night but it sat on my skin and didn't fully absorb. In the morning my face was overly greasy. I did not experience any moisturizing or hydrating benefits.

avis.titre: One of the best I used
avis.texte: This product has a light scent and smells really great. It is a thick rich cream that a little goes along way. I received this product free to test in exchange for an honest review. It really surprised me and it worked wonders on my skin. I'm really happy with this product and would love to buy it again

This moisturizer does it a. It hydrates, it makes you glow, and it cares for your skin. It has a light smell that smells great. It comes in simple easy to use packaging and the cream is super thick so a little goes a long way. After one night of using on my face my face felt so Hydrated and had a nice glow. The hydration is amazing especially if you have dry skin. I received this product free to try in exchange for an honest review.

avis.titre: Works wonders on my dry skin!
avis.texte: I received the Vichy Mineral 89 Moisture Recovery night cream for free in exchange for my honest review. First, the smell.. it's a very subtle and clean smelling, a pleasure to my senses. My skin is extremely dry, but it's hard to find a cream that works that doesn't leave an oily feeling. This cream does not feel oily at all. It leaves my skin feeling moist and silky after putting it on! I also placed it in the fridge and the feeling of putting on a cold cream at night is amazing! When I wake up in the morning my face doesn't feel dry like it's thirsty for more cream! I love this stuff and would recommend it to a friend!

This is on my top 3 favorites list for moisturizers! It gives so much hydration!!! It has a lightweight consistency, moisturizer. Spreads effortlessly over the skin, while penetrating deeply. You can see/feel the hydration from deep within to the surface. Vichy makes many moisturizers and fragrance-free one is my favorite.Despite all the hydrating ingredients. I love that it dries down quickly for an intense hydrator. Highly recommend for sensitive dry skin. I love this product very much and you will love it too .

This product is excellent! I put this on every night and wake up with super super plump and glowy skin. It hasn't irritated my skin at all and not made it oily or greasy either - which is a huge win in my books with many creams making my combination skin greasy. I would highly recommend to everyone!

I love the feel of the Vichy Mineral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream. It is not greasy or gritty feeling when you put it on your face. I have sensitive shin and it doesn't break me out either. I can definitely see results!

I can totally see the difference with this nighttime moisturizer. I can feel my skin drinking it in and the smell is amazing. It also doesn't feel oily or sticky on your face. Your face does have a nice hydration glow afterwards and you wake up with your skin feeling super soft. I would 100% recommend this moisturizer to anyone and would also willingly purchase it to continue using this nighttime moisturizer.
Not too heavy or too light on the skin, this is a nice and moisturizing cream! The price is great for what you're getting as drugstore prices are practically the same amount.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again, my mom loves this cream also
avis.texte: I've recommend this to my friends because of the way my skin feels in the morning. My face is not dry but looked plump and healthy.

avis.titre: I will be adding to my daily routine
avis.texte: This lightweight gel cream is super hydrating. It has a scent to it but doesnt affect my sensitive skin. I havent had any break outs and it leaves my skin hydrated and soft. I will definitely rebuy.

This night cream feels cooling on my skin and I wake up with a hydrated face and the texture seems smooth. Never tried a product with melatonin before but I read it is an antioxidant. I have sensitive skin so was a bit worried about break outs, but it seemed fine. The scent is a bit strong for me but other than that its a great night cream. I got to try this recovery night cream complimentary.

I wanted to get a full effect of this product so I tested it for two weeks and the results are amazing! It has reduced fine lines. It has reduced swelling in the morning. Great product! And great value!

Love this moisturizer! It has a nice creamy feel to it. It has a very faint pleasant smell. It goes on so smooth and my skins feels very soft after applying. No sticky residue. Seems to absorb quicky. I love how it makes my skin look. I would recommend!
This night cream feels luxurious and creamy, but absorbs very well. It makes my skin feel soft and improve the overall texture when I wake up in the morning. Highly recommend!
This is a quality Moisturizer. I have very sensitive skin and it does not break my skin out or make it dry. Has a light feel and not too thick on my skin. Would definitely recommend product.

avis.titre: Skin feels great, fragrance was not my favorite
avis.texte: I'm always on the lookout for you new skin care products and Vichy kindly gave me this Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream for free so that I could review it. I've been using the Moisture Recovery Night Cream for a few weeks, and I've noticed my skin feels more hydrated and looks healthier overall in the mornings. The texture is lighter than I expected for a night cream, but it still provides good overnight moisture without feeling heavy or greasy. I haven't noticed any irritation or breakouts, but I typically don't have very reactive or sensitive skin. The fragrance is supposed to encourage a calm nighttime routine, but in this instance I would personally prefer a lighter scent. Overall, I find it to be a gentle, effective option for boosting hydration and supporting skin recovery overnight..Thanks Vichy!

avis.titre: Great skincare at an affordable price!
avis.texte: At first I thought the packaging was nice, beautiful blue color. I love how it states exactly what it is boldly on packaging. I absolutely love Vichy products so I was excited to try this one. At first opening I did realize a strong smell, it's not an awful smell, it smells okay just a little strong. Otherwise great. I like the consistency of the product and how it made my skin feel. My skin felt smooth and moisturized , I would definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Lightweight & non-greasy feel that absorbs quickly!
avis.texte: This cream has a lightweight, non-greasy feel that absorbs quickly into the skin. I detected a slight scent but it was fresh and natural. My skin still feels moisturized in the morning, and I have noticed some rejuvenation over the two week period that I've been using it. I recommend you adding this product to your skin care routine. I did not experience any allergic reaction while using it.

avis.titre: Luxury product without the price tag
avis.texte: Received this product as part of a free sample program. I think it's an excellent product for its price point. Comparable to the more expensive brands in terms of quality and hydration. Very light scent but not too overwhelming. Not very sticky but does leave a light hydrating layer on your face. Very lightweight and not very thick. I would buy this product again and would recommend to my family and friends especially since it delivers better hydration than some of the more expensive creams without the price tag.

I received a sample of this product, and I used it nightly for 2 weeks. Overall, I was happy with the results. It made my skin look night without being too heavy or greasy. It didn't make me break out or anything like that, and it was a good addition to my regular nightly routine. It does have a strong fragrance which would prevent me from purchasing in the future. It's not a bad fragrance, I'm just not personally a fan of fragrance in my facial products, so it's not for me. If that's not something that bothers you, this is definitely worth trying.

I received a free sample of this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been using it every night for a little over a week now and my skin looks fantastic. Initially, I thought the smell was floral and overpowering, but now I actually find it soothing and to be part of my bedtime routine. My skin looks glowy and plump when I wake up in the morning. I also have sensitive skin and have been dealing with a very stubborn itchy rash on my upper cheeks since February. A week of using this and it's gone! I will definitely recommend this product to others and will be purchasing for myself. I love it so much I even ordered the day cream!

I received this product as a promotion. First look, it is beautiful packaging. Looks like the Agean Sea, the beautiful blue that shows the product through it. There is a good amount of product in the container as well. The cream is silky to the touch and goes on smooth. I am not a fan of the fragrance of the product which is why I gave it the four stars. It does a nice job moisturizing, my skin felt soft, plumped, and moisturized as it says it will. I do have sensitive skin as well and this creme did not irritate. Overall a nice cream, wish I could have tried it in combination with their serum and for longer than a week.

avis.titre: Definitely worked with what it promised
avis.texte: I definitely used this night cream before bed and I have to say that while applying felt like water with a quick drying time that didn't feel drying with wish it provided a more moisturizing feeling while waking up

avis.titre: Great product for a great price
avis.texte: I have been trying this product for a few weeks now and it is amazing! Leaves skin bright and hydrated at night and still looks and feels the same way in the morning.

avis.titre: Silken texture, subtle scent, sensational hydration
avis.texte: I received Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream as part of a free sample program and have used it nightly for the last 2 weeks. I'm really pleased with the firmness of my skin and the hydration level Vichy provides. The lotion absorbs quickly, feels like silk and the mild scent dissipates quickly. I'm sensitive to scents and really enjoy the subtle, almost linen-like scent. Other nighttime lotions tend to be very thick and/or heavily scented, so these qualities separate Vichy Minéral 89 from the competition and will make me a repeat customer!

Lots of good things in the bottle. It's light and not greasy, absorbs quickly and skin feels smooth in the morning. I'm usually not a huge fan of moisturizers because they tend to be heavy, sit on the skin and cause milia, but I haven't had issue with this. There is a light fragrance, If this wasn't a night cream fragrance wouldn't be needed at all- why add scent to a face cream? But the scents include lily of the valley, jasmine, lavender- scents known to be relaxing. I received this as a Sample and I anticipate I'll continue use.

NOTE: I received this product as part of a free sample program. I really like the moisture it gave to my skin, without feeling greasy. There is a light scent to it, which is pleasant and not too perfumed for my sensitive skin. I will likely buy this next time.

avis.titre: Great nighttime moisturizer with a nice scent
avis.texte: I really like this cream. It's lightweight, very moisturizing, and has a great scent. It has become a part of my nighttime wind down routine and one of my bedtime scents. I really enjoy the moisture it provides. I was given this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

This night cream made by Vichy works really good. It not only makes my skin look healthier but it keeps it hydrated as well. I really enjoy putting it on at night and it makes my skin feel so refreshed. I have really seen an improvement since i have been trying it. I recommend this product if you want to have healthier and more glowing skin.

avis.titre: Great product for dry aging skin
avis.texte: I used this product nightly after cleansing my face. After a couple of days I noticed the dry flaky skin around my jawline had greatly improved. I have tried many night creams before and I am very impressed with this one.

I was very excited to try this because my skin had been feeling very dull even after using daily moisturizers. Wow! After the first night using it I woke up to very supple, hydrated skin. I've been using it daily and I'm very happy with the result that it's given me.
Loved the creamy texture and the light oceany scent. Very relaxing part of my evening routine

avis.titre: A good night cream for older ladies
avis.texte: I was happy to be select to try this new Night Cream, as a woman past 55, I'm always looking for a new and better way to fight wrinkles and moisturize my dry skin. What I liked about the cream was that it was very smooth and went on easily, it wasn't too greasy and seemed to absorb well over night. I didn't notice dramatic changes to the skin on my face, but the skin on my neck did appear better after continuous use. What I didn't like about it was that it has a very strong scent, and the unusual blue-green color got some use to. But overall it was a good cream and I would recommend it to older ladies looking for a new night cream.

I generally love French pharmacy products like Vichy, especially their sunscreen and cleansers, so I was excited to try their Mineral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream. And I have to say, I really like it. The texture is silky and lightweight, and it sinks into my skin beautifully, leaving it feeling plump and hydrated by morning. It's not greasy at all, which is exactly what I need for a night cream. The price is also extremely reasonable compared to other night creams that boasts the same benefits That said, the scent isn't my favorite. While it's pleasant, I tend to go for fragrance-free products or naturally scented products, and this one lingers a bit longer than I'd prefer. But if you're not sensitive to fragrance, it's a nice touch.

avis.titre: Great night cream for dry skin
avis.texte: The cream has a light pleasant floral scent. It is lightweight, absorbs very quickly, and doesn't make my skin greasy. After applying it at night for more than 1 week, I feel my skin softer, smoother, and more hydrated. My skin looks healthier and more glowing. I think it is a great night cream to help improve and recover for dry skin.
I really like this night cream. At least my face feeling moisturize without it feeling too thick. The scent is also light and mild.
Shocked at this moisturizer. Typically I like thicker night creams…this is very thin… but packs a punch. STRONG fragrance!!! Smells like my grandma

This cream makes my face feel incredibly smooth. It's like a hug for your face! My skin instantly feels deeply moisturized upon application. I enjoy the light scent and love the light blue color. Works for my normal to dry skin.

This cream is fantastic. I work all day in the city so I'm exposed to a lot of environmental elements. My face gets dry. This cream solves that problem. It keeps my face hydrated and looking great. It is easy to put on and it absorbs quickly I highly recommend it to everyone

I have very acne prone skin even at 39 years old. This didn't agitate my skin in any way and it seems to be a bit plumper in any fine line areas since I've started using it a week and a half ago. Bonus points for not feeling heavy or sticky!
It's a lightweight, absorbs well moisturizer for the face. I like that it's not heavy nor greasy. Has a light fresh scent also

The Vichy Mineral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream delivers long-lasting hydration and helps repair and restore dry skin while you sleep. It feels very silky and luxurious and applies very easily. My skin immediately feels enveloped in rich, protective moisture. Quality ingredients include Melatonin, Hyaluronic Acid, and Volcanic Water to strengthen skin's natural barrier, hdrate, brighten, and plump. By morning, I wake up looking refreshed and glowing. Besides all the skin benefits, I also love using this as the last step in my night time skin routine because it has a delicate scent of lavender, lily of the valley, white musk, and night jasmine – just relaxing and soothing! I highly recommend this product and will keep it as a key step in my skin routine. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

Wow, this moisturizer is great. The texture is perfect and the products absorbs SO nicely. It's similar in texture to a gel moisturizer but feels a lot more moisturizing than a typical gel moisturizer without being heavy. It does have a scent, but I honestly find it to be a nice luxurious smell! I was sent this product for my honest review and it is now going to be a staple in my nightly skin care routine.
I've been using this product nightly and I love it. The scent took some getting used to but now I find it very relaxing.

I would use the product regularly. I plan to continue with it and see how I'm looking after the month and will probably purchase it from thereon out. It is a perfect cream consistency. It's not super thick or loose and the scent is light and pleasant. Normally you get a lavender scent in night time skincare routine products (and I strongly dislike lavender). It absorbs and dries quickly on your skin.

avis.titre: Not as moisturizing as I would've hoped.
avis.texte: I used the Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream in my nightly routine, and honestly, it's just okay. I have combination skin, and instead of soaking in, it kind of just sat on top of my face. It's not super moisturizing, and while it's not bad, it's not something I'd reach for again. I'm used to thicker, richer night creams that leave my skin looking hydrated and refreshed, and this one didn't really do that. My skin felt dull and not as rejuvenated as I hoped. Just keeping it real.

avis.titre: Vichy laboratories mineral 89 moisture recovery night cream
avis.texte: this product is nice to my skin. It left it hydrated, smooth definitely glowing and I like the fact that it's for sensitive skin. I would highly recommend this product. It's like having a spa day in your bathroom. I like the fact that it's not sticky.
The cream goes on very nicely and my face feels soft and sort of glowy. It also absorbs very well! I don't however recognize any benefit of the melantonin in the product. Great night cream though.

avis.titre: A great moisturizer for an even better value!
avis.texte: I am absolutely loving this moisturizer! Over the past few years I have gotten much more serious about my skincare routines. A great nighttime moisturizer is something I cannot be without as I use a retinol which can dry out your skin. This moisturizer has an amazing texture and just a hint of a scent which I love! It feels so luxurious on my skin and I would say it even competes with some of the pricier moisturizers I have tried. The quality of product for the price point is definitely worth it in this case, and I would absolutely recommend this to friends. I will be repurchasing and am now interested in trying more products from this line!

avis.titre: This is the product I would maybe continue using!
avis.texte: I have used this product for a few weeks now, and I like the way it leaving my skin hydrated and plump! I like the texture of the cream, but I'm not a fan of the scent! I am writing this review because I received a free product.
Very good. Cream feels good on the skin and it has really nice scent. After applying it to my face I think I had really good sleep.
I received this product as part of a free sample program. I love this moisturizer! I wake up to soft and supple skin. I will definitely add this as part of my regular routine to combat aging!

avis.titre: This product does exactly what it states.
avis.texte: I put the cream on my face and other areas that were dry every night for a week and I have noticed a huge difference. The scent is great and it doesn't leave your skin feeling greasy. I would highly recommend this product to others!

I'm so far loving the Vichy Mineral 89 crème. I have tried so many different creams and lotions and there's so many I do not like. This one is so light but also moisturizing. It doesn't make my skin feel like it's coated and it can breath. It smells amazing and is formulated with hyaluronic acid, minerals and vitamins B3 and E. I will continue to use this product and highly recommend!

I have been using this cream at night. It does exactly what it should do-my skin is so hydrated and soft in the morning. I rinse my face with water in the morning as part of my regular routine. I don't need to add an additional moisturizer. It maintains its softness during the day as well. Very happy with this face cream.

avis.titre: New Favorite Night Cream for Summer!
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I didn't know what to expect since I'd never used any Vichy products before, but I've been reaching for this night cream over my usual go-to ever since I got the sample. The texture is light and whipped—it feels great going on, smooth and not greasy. The scent is fresh and calming, and it sinks in quickly without feeling heavy. When I wake up, my face feels soft and moisturized. It's honestly one of the best I've tried—especially great for summer when you want hydration without heaviness. I'll definitely keep using it, and I'd absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a lightweight, hydrating night cream.
This product is non greasy and smells good! I use it on dry spots a couple times a week. It doesn't leave me feeling greasy. And it made my dry spots smooth and soft.

avis.titre: Hydration That Works While You Sleep
avis.texte: Finally found a night cream that hydrates without clogging or irritating — my skin feels soft, calm, and refreshed

I've been searching for a facial cream that truly hydrates without feeling heavy or greasy, and I finally found it. This cream is incredibly soothing on my dry, sensitive skin and has made a noticeable difference in just a couple of weeks. My skin feels softer, smoother, and looks more radiant — even the fine lines around my mouth and eyes seem less pronounced. What I love most is the texture. It's rich but absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling plump and hydrated all day. There's no irritation, no fragrance overload, and it layers well under makeup. I use it morning and night, and I've noticed that my skin no longer feels tight or flaky by midday. For anyone dealing with dryness, flakiness, or that dull feeling that often comes with aging skin, I can't recommend this enough. It feels like a spa treatment in a jar — gentle, effective, and worth every penny.

Well, I really enjoyed this face cream! I used it for a few nights in a row and my skin feels really nice! I'm always in search for rich night creams, but my previous brand was a little too greasy and this became a game changer. Also, I love the scent, it is very gentle and pleasant. The cream feels nice on skin, doesn't leave sticky residue. For the reference I'm 30 y.o and have a combination skin. I highly recommend trying it if you're looking for a good night cream.

avis.titre: easy to reach for at the end of the day
avis.texte: It has this quiet, comforting quality that makes it easy to reach for at the end of the day. The texture is somewhere between a cream and a balm, it feels rich going on but sinks in fast, leaving behind a soft, cushioned finish that doesn't feel greasy or heavy. I like that it gives immediate relief on dry or stressed skin without overwhelming it, like it's wrapping your face in a calm, breathable layer.

I was gifted this product to try as part of the BzzAgent program. I'm an advanced skincare user and I really liked the texture of this cream, as well as how quickly it absorbed into skin. I found the melatonin component to be highly effective, almost too effective -- some may not believe that topical melatonin could be strong enough to cause vivid dreams sometimes associated with melatonin supplementation, but after using this for a week I experienced this side effect in a way similar to when I take oral melatonin. Aside from that, the cream has a smooth texture and left my skin feeling hydrated but not weighed down.
This is so deeply hydrating I absolutely love this. This is better than most expensive skincare. I use this at night and I wake up with plump skin!

This Vichy mineral 89 sunscreen is very light and moisturizing. It's not sticky and feels "clean". I keep this on my nightstand and put it on before bed for nightime moisturizing. Keeps my skin clear and moisturized!

I'm really impressed with how hydrating this recovery night cream is. It's a really good texture and a little goes along way. I'm really enjoying it in my nighttime skincare routine. I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: Nice texture but not the best night cream I've ever used
avis.texte: I loved the texture of this cream! It's very silky and goes on without feeling greasy or sticky. It smells pretty good. I'm not displeased with the results but wouldn't say this night cream works better than anything else I've used. I don't wake up feeling quite as a glowy as I'd like to, but my skin does feel like it soaked in the moisture from the cream.

avis.titre: Definitely will buy again! Perfect moisturizer!
avis.texte: I love this product! It has the perfect feel to it - not greasy or heavy, just feels like clean moisturizer. I was delighted by its pretty blue color when I opened the jar, it looks and feels high end. I like the smell, it's relaxing to me. While I received this for free to demo I will definitely buy again.

avis.titre: Overnight Hydration Hero for Radiant Skin
avis.texte: Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream is a game-changer for tired, dehydrated skin. Its lightweight yet nourishing formula absorbs quickly, delivering intense hydration without feeling greasy. Infused with Vichy volcanic water and hyaluronic acid, it strengthens the skin barrier overnight, leaving skin plump, refreshed, and visibly smoother by morning. Perfect for sensitive skin, it restores moisture and radiance while you sleep—an essential addition to any nighttime routine.

avis.titre: Great Texture, But Too Scented and Sticky
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this night cream, but a few things just didn't work for me. The scent is very strong and reminds me of an old-fashioned perfume—definitely not something I want lingering on my face at night. It also leaves a sticky residue, and once it dries down, if you run your finger across your skin, it tends to ball up and flake off, which is frustrating. That said, it does feel very moisturizing, and I love the whipped gel texture, it's lightweight and smooth going on. If Vichy released a fragrance-free version and adjusted the formula to prevent the pilling, I'd give it another shot.

Been using this moisturizer for days now and I really love how moisturizing it is. The texture is light but really hydrating, it glides on smoothly and sinks in quickly without feeling sticky or greasy. Perfect for nights when I want hydration without piling on a heavy cream. It also has a soft, relaxing fragrance that feels really soothing before bed which I love.
